reason: As a frugal solo practitioner, I am not paying ₹12,990 upfront until I see with my own eyes that an assistant accidentally deleting or moving a Drive folder won't destroy our files. In a normal week, I would only ever test the ₹0 free pilot first to verify that Google Drive restoration works and that it actually cuts down my Saturday GST reconciliation time.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and can Docketra really restore it seamlessly without data loss?
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that accidental folder deletion or moving in Google Drive is immediately detected and restored with one click, without corrupting client files.
